column1: # Game profile of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion (Switch, base game and update 1.10 in one NSP, v589824, which the porter reads as v0). Starts on Android (Retroid Pocket Nova)
# FNA 25.3 (XNA 4 reimplemented in C#) compiled with .NET NativeAOT, SDL 3, FMOD Studio, SDK 20.5.29. Epic Online Services comes as an NRO (nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro), which the
# host refuses as an online SDK: the EOS calls main imports are answered offline (dm/host/fork_eos_offline.c).
# Rendering: on the console FNA3D draws through SDL_GPU on Vulkan (subsdk0, NintendoSDK_Vulkan). The hosts have no Vulkan for a game (vkGetInstanceProcAddr is unimplemented), SDL_GPU
# finds no backend, and FNA3D falls back to its OpenGL driver. patches.py makes that driver ask for an OpenGL ES 3 context (its FNA3D_OPENGL_FORCE_ES3 path) instead of desktop
# OpenGL, and hands the host the renderer; android.tsv turns on the host's run of the driver's command list (DM_FNA3D_GL_PUMP), without which the game stops before its first frame
# The game ships Korean text (Content/Global/Loc/Korean.zpbn, chosen in its options or by the system language) but its control data lists no ko: porter --language ko is allowed
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan), subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: the game maps its memory itself in address regions of the alias region.
# nninitStartup takes StandardAllocator::Initialize(nullptr, 40 GB) and nnMain then asks AllocateAddressRegion for 20 GB more (0x500000000, the .NET GC's region range): 60 GB of
# address space, which a 4.375 GB alias region refused (abort before the first frame). The block is 256 MB in front + a 64 GB alias region (the console's, with virtual address
# memory) + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region; 0.5 to 0.8 GB of it is mapped from the start to the main menu. The SDK's address region manager needs its node area cut for
# a region this size (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py, sdk a5813da3…)
# (the game compiles GLSL that MojoShader writes at run time, profile glsles3: nothing is translated ahead)
